_comment: Site config template. deploy/install.sh renders it once into /etc/spark-swapper/models.json ({{USER}}, {{PUBLIC_HOST}} and {{OPENCLAW_BIN}} become real values) and never overwrites it afterwards. The models themselves come from catalog.json, which ships with every release, so updates bring new models. To change a model on this box, add an entry with the same key under "models" here: its fields are merged over the catalog's (this file wins). "hidden_models" hides catalog models; "platform" forces nvidia-gb10 or amd-strix-halo instead of detecting it.
